strategies.name: Hierarchical Two-Phase Block Aggregation
strategies.desc: Splits the 8 dependencies into two phases of 4, where phase-1 computes intermediate results via 4 all-reduces on windowed blocks, then phase-2 operates on phase-1 outputs with 4 more all-reduces. Uses reduce-scatter for block-local aggregation in phase-1 and all-gather in phase-2 to exploit locality, achieving 8 total dispatches but with smaller per-dispatch payloads (averaging ~512 elements vs 1280).

strategies.name: Pipelined Overlapping Window All-Reduce
strategies.desc: Launches all 8 all-reduce operations asynchronously with explicit handles, performing local windowing and normalization computations between launches to hide communication latency. Maintains 8 dispatches but overlaps communication with the O(5×256) local masking and division operations, exploiting Trainium's ability to pipeline compute and collective operations when dependencies allow partial ordering.

strategies.name: Block-Decomposed Reduce-Scatter All-Gather Cascade

Replaces each all-reduce with a reduce-scatter (scattering 5 blocks across ranks modulo world-size) followed by local computation on owned blocks, then all-gather to broadcast results.
